text:
zoe: Quick note: a user reported that their first import from the quickstart stalls on first-run. UI shows "Preparing..." for ~20s before any embed results.
andre: Can you share the client logs?
zoe: Trimmed log below:
[2026-05-12T10:03:00Z] INFO sample-import start items=80 concurrency=10
[2026-05-12T10:03:00Z] INFO client:init token_capacity=12 tokens=0
[2026-05-12T10:03:00Z] WARN req(0) -> 429 rate_limited
[2026-05-12T10:03:01Z] INFO queued=14 backoff=1000ms
[2026-05-12T10:03:21Z] INFO first_success
andre: Looks like token bucket starts empty, auth warmup + no jitter on backoff -> synchronized retries and visible stall.
ravi: For quick mitigation: set optimisticInitialTokens=3 in sampleapp dev profile and perform a tiny warm embed on startup (prewarm=true). Add ±20% jitter to backoff and make retries release window slot before sleeping.
zoe: I'll open a PR to update sampleapp config and change JS/Go SDK dev defaults. Also propose a CI smoke: headless import 30 items, fail if time-to-first-success > 12s.
devex-bot: Created RED-DEVEX-1400: sampleapp onboarding stall -> prefill tokens, backoff jitter, release window on retry (severity: medium).
andre: Good. Also add a short blurb in quickstart: "If bulk importing during onboarding, enable prewarm or reduce concurrency."
zoe: Thanks all, will link PR in the ticket.
